knack: Trade goods, prices, and a shrewd bargain.
item: A trading house's seal, still good for credit.
complication: The house counts you its own, and sends word when it wants a thing bought or sold.

knack: Travelers, rumor, and a host's welcome.
item: A tavern key, and a reckoning the regulars never settled.
complication: A death or a debt means the family inn wants you home to keep it.

knack: Field labor, rough shelter, and going unmissed.
item: A forged pass, the ink still too fresh.
complication: Your old lord's men still hunt an escaped serf.

knack: Ranks, camp routine, and battle signals.
item: A cashiered man's blade, the crest filed off.
complication: Old comrades blame you, or want an answer.

knack: Heraldry, court manners, and highborn address.
item: A signet your family would see you stop using.
complication: Your kin deny you, pursue you, or resent you.

knack: Spell components, reagents, and careful handling.
item: A satchel of labelled jars, two unlabelled.
complication: You cast no spells by this, and your master's debts may find you.

knack: Decks, sea commands, and reckoning a course.
item: A cross-staff, and a mate's note of wages unpaid.
complication: Your old master wants his ship or his cut, and the ports know your name.

knack: Reciting, mimicry, and a passing impression.
item: A trunk of costume and one good mask.
complication: The troupe-master holds your indenture, and a patron expects you on his feast days.

knack: A great house's ways, its kin, and its quarrels.
item: A token of the house that fostered you, half a promise.
complication: The house holds a claim on your loyalty your own blood resents.

knack: Ambush ground, a band's discipline, and reading a mark.
item: A chief's token that still buys silence on the roads.
complication: The band wants you back or dead, and the law has your description.

knack: Law, records, and the names behind the seals.
item: A court roll naming debts and crimes not yet called in.
complication: A verdict you set down made an enemy with a long reach.

knack: A craft's tools, stock, and hidden flaws.
item: A journeyman's token that opens guild doors.
complication: Your oath still binds you; the guild wants its dues and may call you to the bench.

knack: Liturgy, the calendar, and a cloister's letters.
item: A child's vow-cord you never cut.
complication: The temple reckons you still owed to it, and an abbot may recall the debt.

knack: Hidden goods, quiet ports, and discreet contacts.
item: A coat of many pockets, two still full.
complication: Old partners expect their cut, and the watch keeps your name on a list.

knack: Remedies, poisons, and who buys which.
item: A case of phials, two labels worn to nothing.
complication: A customer died of what you sold, and the family asks who mixed it.

knack: Roads, reading a skyline, and holding a column together.
item: A caravan-seal still honored at the toll-gates.
complication: A caravan you led was lost, and its backers hold you to the debt.

knack: Doctrine, charity, and the needs of the poor.
item: An alms-box with a false bottom, long empty.
complication: The order still names you its almoner, and expects the alms accounted for.

knack: Rents, boundaries, and the handling of men.
item: A deed with a boundary the next lord disputes.
complication: A neighbor lord presses your bounds, and the land wants a hand on it while you are gone.

knack: Letters, old tongues, and the reading of stars.
item: A brass astrolabe, one scale bent.
complication: Your patron still expects a horoscope, and takes a bad forecast ill.

knack: Far customs, strange tongues, and distant roads.
item: Coins from a realm no one here will trade.
complication: You cannot go home, and here you are a stranger.
